---
name: Asset or interface contribution
about: Propose or claim a task-relevant asset or robot interface
---

## Need and identity
Asset ID/version, task and operation IDs, existing alternatives and duplicate search:

## Deliverable and ownership
Geometry, appearance, interaction or binding scope; proposed owner; dependencies and agreed interfaces:

## Real equipment identity and resource search
Commercial or custom apparatus; manufacturer, model/part number, generation/options; paper/SI configuration locators; unresolved identity and selected reconstruction hypothesis:

Dated searches of official product pages, manuals, dimension drawings, CAD portals and multiple product views; inspected URLs/locators, unsuccessful searches, model matches and reuse terms:

## Physical and interaction contract
Dimensions/units/frames, display scale, states, ports, support/grasp targets, attachment/release, collision representation:

Operation-to-part mapping, robot motion/manipulation and observations; omitted handling reconstructed with assumptions; loading/access/unloading paths and relevant state variants:

## Provenance and limits
Original author or source URLs, licenses/attribution, missing dimensions, unknown physics and unimplemented interactions:

## Acceptance evidence
Planned files, screenshots, tests if applicable, readiness claim and next step:

For equipment, plan matched reference/model views, a dimension and inference ledger, discrepancy resolution, exact reviewed file hashes and separate reviewer decisions using the [equipment standard](https://github.com/openags/ScienceGym/blob/main/docs/contributing/EQUIPMENT_MODELING_STANDARD.md) and [review record](https://github.com/openags/ScienceGym/blob/main/docs/contributing/templates/equipment_modeling_review.example.json). A generic labeled shell or a static test pass cannot establish faithful equipment reconstruction.
